definitions.explanation: A bottle that has been emptied of its contents. Commonly encountered in the context of recycling and waste separation in Japan.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{瓶|びん}は{資源|しげん}ごみに{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please put empty bottles out with the recyclables.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{隅|すみ}に{空|あ}き{瓶|びん}がたくさん{転|ころ}がっていた。
examples.english: There were many empty bottles lying around in the corner of the yard.

notes: Composed of {空|あ}き (empty, vacant) + {瓶|びん} (bottle). Part of a series with {空|あ}き{缶|かん} (empty can) and {空|あ}き{箱|ばこ} (empty box). In Japanese garbage separation systems, {空|あ}き{瓶|びん} are typically classified as {資源|しげん}ごみ (recyclable waste) and collected separately. The prefix {空|あ}き- is productive: {空|あ}き{家|や} (vacant house), {空|あ}き{地|ち} (vacant lot), {空|あ}き{室|しつ} (vacant room).
